# Masakali Indian Restobar (Ottawa)

> Masakali Indian Restobar is part of Masakali Group. This website covers the Restobar at 97 Clarence St. in Ottawa's Byward Market — Indian dining, bar, menu, reservations, catering, and contact.

## Restaurant group
- Parent organization: Masakali Group
- Brand on this site: Masakali Indian Restobar
- Sister brands: Masakali Indian Cuisine (Stittsville & Wellington, Ottawa; Montreal; Cupertino, California), RangDe Indian Cuisine (Kanata)
- Cuisine: Indian (North Indian and South Indian specialties)
- Services: dine-in, bar, takeout, delivery (via Clover online ordering where available), catering, reservations

## Menu & recommendations
- Full menu: https://masakalirestobar.ca/menu
- Signature dishes: Butter Chicken; Chicken Dum Biryani; Paneer Butter Masala
- Chef recommended: Chicken Tikka Masala; Tandoori Chicken; Lamb Vindaloo
- Vegetarian specialities: Chana Masala; Yellow Dal Tadka; Shahi Paneer
- Non-vegetarian specialities: Butter Chicken Biryani; Chicken 65 Biryani; Shahi Gosht Biryani (Mutton)
- Must-try: Garlic Naan; Mango Lassi; Gulab Jamun
- Restobar specialities: Butter Gravy Wings; Butter Chicken Nachos; Chilli Garlic Naan
- Note: Recommendations are curated signature/chef picks from the menu — not fabricated sales rankings. Confirm availability on the live menu.
